comparisons.peer_summary: Investment management revenues totaled $10.60 billion in 2024, an 11% increase over 2023, primarily due to higher management and other fees reflecting the impact of higher average assets under supervision (AUS).
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS attribute increases in their respective asset management/investment management revenues primarily to higher average assets under supervision/management driven by equity market valuations. BAC explicitly cites 'higher average equity market valuations' as a key driver for its $2.2 billion increase in investment and brokerage services, alongside AUM flows. Similarly, GS reports an 11% increase in investment management revenues, attributing it 'primarily reflecting the impact of higher average assets under supervision (AUS)' which in turn was driven by market levels, mirroring the valuation driver cited by BAC.
